title: You Are Here
coreMove: Treating hours only as tools makes life feel like prelude; the Here-Not-Later Check lets the present count before it becomes another task.

exampleSpecs.audience: attorneys noticing work accounting at home
exampleSpecs.stakes: The billable-hour habit may make unpaid family time feel suspect.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show work accounting leaking into personal value.

exampleSpecs.audience: owners who defer enjoyment to future success
exampleSpecs.stakes: A celebration can become another step toward a later payoff.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Keynes's purposive person to catch enjoyment being deferred.

exampleSpecs.audience: travel producers reviewing why a trip felt flat
exampleSpecs.stakes: A famous view can arrive already burdened by the reaction it is supposed to produce.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show anticipated wonder dulling direct contact.

exampleSpecs.audience: travel guides helping guests stop optimizing awe
exampleSpecs.stakes: Trying to capture maximum meaning can interrupt the display itself.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the attempt to relish northern lights getting in the way.

exampleSpecs.audience: professionals who turn family routines into metrics
exampleSpecs.stakes: Personal life can become a performance ledger after work ends.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show billable-hour thinking losing its grip on one family moment.

exampleSpecs.audience: program leads balancing funders and visitors
exampleSpecs.stakes: A public program can become only a bridge to next year's grant.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show purposiveness turning current visitors into future proof.
